angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 53,081,910 km at 46661.20 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12505: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 46661.2 +/- 4095 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 46661.2 +/- 4095 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0018 +/- 0.0159 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00), -0.1 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 76.3 +/- 6.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12505: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 76.3 +/- 6.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 53,081,910 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5000 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0504, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5000 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0504, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5000 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.46 from 2022AJ....163..152S (APOGEE Net, a survey pipeline: no analysis of this star's own spectra is published); the 2 published values span log g 0.925 to 1.46, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.8% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..152S)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
